raushan-kumar.bioHtml: MoneyMinded is founded and edited by Raushan Kumar. He researches each guide from reputable, publicly available sources, verifies the figures, and reviews and edits every article before it is published. MoneyMinded may use AI-assisted tools while drafting, but published content is reviewed under the site's editorial standards. Raushan is not a licensed financial adviser; MoneyMinded shares general education, not personalized advice.
